correctness.rationale: The C6 repulsive discrete phase map is conjugate on a bipartite cycle to an attractive gradient step. At any fixed point the lifted update is less than 2π in each coordinate and hence stationary. Current conservation gives five strong-edge increments with common sine J; Hessian on five independent edge increments Q=c sum x_i^2+w cos(5α)(sum x_i)^2. Any nonpositive strong cosine excludes a strictly positive Hessian (difference vectors give Q<=0 or degeneracy). Thus all are α in (-π/2,π/2) and sin α+w sin5α=0. The exact Chebyshev square U4(t)+5/4=(8t²−3)²/4 gives fold w=4/5. Branch inertia yields one synchronous sink always and two additional chiral sinks iff w>4/5, with explicit α_saddle/α_sink. At equality the extra equilibria have zero transverse eigenvalue; 0<h<1/λmax(Lw) ensures no discrete multiplier sign change. Independently checked square identity and sampled Hessian signatures; 7 sample weights are not an exhaustive parameter proof.

Best-of-knowledge originality attaches only to that new full-domain conclusion; deriving some angles from the earlier scalar relation may be straightforward, but completion of previously unclassified strong-link regime and all-sinks exhaustiveness is nontrivial.
